get.description:
Return the full aggregated state for a user:
  - admitted_up_to_id: int    — admission watermark; report ids <= this are
                                admitted to the sidebar (see UserAdmission)
  - flagged_authors: list[str]
  - hide_ids: list[int]       — reports marked as seen/hidden
  - acknowledged_ids: list[int] — reports the user has explicitly opened
  - location_overrides: dict  — {str(report_id): list[LocationEntry]}

DotDTO.title: DotDTO
DotDTO.description:
A single map-dot, one per geocoded location (not one per report — a
report with 3 locations yields 3 of these pre-clustering). Matches the dict
build_dots() constructs; giving it a real schema (rather than list[dict])
is what lets the frontend's DotDTO type be generated from this schema
instead of hand-maintained in parallel.

ReportsBundleResponse.title: ReportsBundleResponse
ReportsBundleResponse.description:
Reports list + map dots in one payload, so a filter change needs a single
round trip instead of two parallel requests contending on one sync worker.
